title: Models that learn how humans learn: The case of decision-making and its disorders
description: A recurrent neural network trained to predict the next action on a two-armed bandit task (healthy controls n = 34, unipolar depression n = 34, bipolar n = 33) is compared with Q-learning, Q-learning with perseveration, generalised Q-learning and a logistic-regression baseline. Models are compared by leave-one-subject-out cross-validation within each group, using negative log-probability of the withheld subject's actions and percentage of actions predicted; off-policy simulations are used to interpret the network.
